submittedInput.context: I registered for a free community event and received this message.

body.title: Keep account codes private
body.nextStep: Do not send your password or account verification code to another person.
body.reason:
“I registered for a free community event and received this message.” does not authorise the separate request “Send me the one-time login code
from your email so I can add you
to the list.”. Sharing a password or account code, or approving another person’s sign-in, can give them account access.
body.uncertainty: The sender’s identity and intentions have not been verified. Screenshot text is machine-transcribed and may contain mistakes. The screenshot does not establish the sender’s identity.

evidence.title: Keep banking credentials private
evidence.detail: DBS advises against giving another person banking credentials, one-time passwords or Digital Token approvals. This source concerns account authentication; it does not classify ordinary parcel-collection codes. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.

extraction.transcript:
EVENT CHECK-IN

Please bring your confirmation email.
Show your name at the welcome desk.

One more step:
Send me the one-time login code
from your email so I can add you
to the list.

No payment is needed.
